title: L02 PLUMB-HOUND — B
status: scale/layout guide only; not concept art; not approved

weapon_cell.contents: the plumb cord with its fixing ring / harness, coiled (no separate bob is invented)

notes: paws lift 0.10-0.20H above the baseline in the 3/4 view (estimate); the shoulder then sits at ~0.80-0.90H in that view (derived: lift + V)
the hanging 3/4 keeps V and L; the turnarounds on the baseline are only the V measurement

view_notes.3/4: the stone hound hangs from the plumb cord attached at its back, the cord rising toward the top edge; swinging; paws 0.10-0.20H above the baseline; V 0.70H and L 1.35H keep their values; no glow
view_notes.LEFT/RIGHT/FRONT/BACK: turnarounds stand on the baseline, for the V 0.70H measurement only

no_glow: Lodge servant: never self-lit — no glow, no glowing eyes/edges/fire (Quy chuẩn §2.4, artdirection §6.3)
